edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow (“Plaintiff”) and Defendant Delmar (“Defendant”) wish to resolve the dispute concerning [identify the underlying events, subject matter, and, if applicable, action caption, court, and case number] (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT SUBJECT TO CLIENT CONFIRMATION] (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after this Agreement has been signed by both parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Plaintiff shall provide wire instructions promptly following execution.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff Harrow releases Defendant Delmar from all claims and causes of action arising out of the Dispute and based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement has been signed by both parties. This release does not extend to unrelated matters or to rights or obligations under this Agreement, including the right to enforce it.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers, as required by law or legal process, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party disclosing terms to its advisers shall inform them of their confidential nature and request that they maintain confidentiality. Where legally permitted and reasonably practicable, a party making a legally required disclosure shall give the other party advance notice and disclose only what is required.
4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement is a compromise of disputed claims. Neither this Agreement nor payment of the Settlement Amount constitutes an admission of liability or wrongdoing by either party.
